===Pokémon Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon===
Burnet made her [[core series]] debut in [[Pokémon Sun and Moon]], where she is revealed to have married [[Professor Kukui]] of [[Alola]]. Three months prior to the start of the story, Burnet had found [[Lillie]] lying on a beach, with a weakened {{p|Cosmog}} named [[Nebby]] in her bag. She contacts her husband who proceeds bring the young girl to {{rt|1|alola}} to live in the Pokémon Research Lab's Loft. Ever since, she and her husband have been helping Lillie find out more about Nebby. After the {{player}} completes the three [[Island challenge#trial|island trial]]s in [[Akala Island]], Kukui invites the player to the Dimensional Research Lab in [[Heahea City]], where she has been researching the strange phenomena occurring in the Alola region, [[Ultra Wormhole]]s and the [[Ultra Beast]]s. Burnet offers the player the [[Reveal Glass]] later in the games. In Sun and Moon, Lillie leaves for the [[Kanto]] region in hopes of helping her mother, Professor Kukui makes the claim that Burnet was too sad to see Lillie go and that she is allowed to use the space in the loft whenever she pleases. Burnet and Professor Kukui suggest that [[Z-Power]] comes from Ultra Wormholes.

Professor Burnet appears alongside her husband and his [[Professor Kukui's Lycanroc|Rockruff]] during the credits of Sun and Moon. This photograph is implied to have been taken by the {{player}} and was sent to Lillie in a package.

Her role in [[Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon]] is nearly identical, with only the ending of the game being changed as Lillie never leaves Alola.
